userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 RuleBench 的初级工程师。每轮只推进一个目标，可以询问职责、接口、语义、状态、数据流和证据，但绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、解析算法、并发方案、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read the contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers delivery and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件，给出分阶段计划、风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.objective: Explain module and process ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: Authorities and boundaries are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 API、规则版本、验证、Evaluation、Worker、dispatcher、PostgreSQL 和 UI 的职责与依赖。

scenes.title: Evaluation flow
scenes.objective: Explain publish, evaluate, replay, and failure flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Atomic effects and forbidden side effects are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明一次发布、正常 Evaluation、响应丢失和 replay 的完整数据流与原子边界。

scenes.title: Rule semantics
scenes.objective: Explain type, priority, short-circuit, and explanation semantics.
scenes.advanceGate: All deterministic semantics are unambiguous.
scenes.safeMessage: 请逐项说明表达式类型、缺失与 null、priority、terminal、tags、SKIPPED 和 Explanation 顺序。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Author OpenAPI, states, errors, Work, Events, and snapshot.
scenes.advanceGate: Public contracts are complete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、精确输入输出、状态、错误、Work、Event 和 snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Test strategy
scenes.objective: Define realistic verification layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Each layer proves distinct invariants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、真实 PostgreSQL Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Performance 分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.objective: Build the runnable production skeleton.
scenes.advanceGate: All roles boot and stop.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 API、React、PostgreSQL、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架并 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement atomic persistence bootstrap.
scenes.advanceGate: Replay and invalid seed behavior pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证合法导入、同 digest 重放、版本冲突、非法引用和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Rule authoring
scenes.objective: Implement bounded expressions and canonical version drafts.
scenes.advanceGate: Language boundaries pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 RuleSet、draft RuleSetVersion、表达式校验和 canonical digest，并验证所有边界。

scenes.title: Conflicts
scenes.objective: Implement deterministic static conflict reports.
scenes.advanceGate: Every published conflict is rejected atomically.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成重复 priority、unreachable、非法 terminal 和结构相同冲突检测，验证报告稳定排序。

scenes.title: Publication
scenes.objective: Implement immutable publication and revision races.
scenes.advanceGate: Only one legal publication result exists.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 publish、不可变版本、revision 冲突和双 API 并发发布验证。

scenes.title: Evaluation
scenes.objective: Implement durable asynchronous Evaluation.
scenes.advanceGate: Decision and frozen identity are correct.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Evaluation 接受、version/facts 冻结、Work、幂等和终态决定。

scenes.title: Explanation
scenes.objective: Implement ordered explanation and short-circuit evidence.
scenes.advanceGate: Digest and nodes are deterministic.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 ExplanationNode、visited leaf、SKIPPED rule、matchedRuleIds、tags 和 explanationDigest 验证。

scenes.title: Replay
scenes.objective: Implement deterministic ReplayRun.
scenes.advanceGate: Replay matches original without mutation.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 frozen version/facts replay，验证 MATCHED、DIVERGED 边界和原 Evaluation 不可变。

scenes.title: Concurrency and recovery
scenes.objective: Exercise multi-process replay and controlled crashes.
scenes.advanceGate: No stale or duplicate commit remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行双 API、多 Worker、响应丢失、同 key 竞争、barrier SIGKILL 和 outbox unknown ACK。

scenes.title: UI
scenes.objective: Complete real production UI and browser flows.
scenes.advanceGate: All visible V1 workflows pass Chromium.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 RuleSet、version、conflict、publish、Evaluation、Explanation、Replay 和 Work UI，并运行 production Chromium。

scenes.title: V1 review
scenes.objective: Complete findings-first V1 review.
scenes.advanceGate: No material V1 finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做 V1 findings-first Review，重点检查语义、冲突、幂等、解释、回放、恢复、隔离和测试真实性。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.objective: Plan ComparisonRun without coding.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan covers all affected layers.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Product Manager】新增 Shadow ComparisonRun。ComparisonRun={comparisonRunId,tenantId,ruleSetId,baselineVersionId,candidateVersionId,evaluationIds,corpusDigest,state:PENDING|RUNNING|COMPLETED|CANCELLED|FAILED,revision,resultCounts:{MATCH,DIFF,ERROR},createdAt,startedAt,completedAt,cancelledAt,promotedAt}。创建时冻结同一 RuleSet 的两个已发布版本，将 1..100,000 个 completed Evaluation ID 去重后按 UUID 升序保存；corpusDigest 是该 ID 数组的 RFC 8785-compatible canonical JSON SHA-256。ComparisonResult={comparisonRunId,evaluationId,ordinal,status:MATCH|DIFF|ERROR,baseline:{decision,tags,explanationDigest}|null,candidate:{decision,tags,explanationDigest}|null,errorCode:string|null,resultDigest}。resultDigest 是除自身外这些字段的 canonical JSON SHA-256。MATCH 表示两侧 decision、tags 和 explanationDigest 全部相同；DIFF 表示两侧均成功但至少一项不同；ERROR 表示任一侧无法产生合法确定性结果，例如排序比较读取到非 safe-integer facts。ERROR 不可由 Worker 或客户端标记为已解释；本版本没有豁免 API，因此只要 resultCounts.ERROR > 0 就禁止 promotion。新增 HTTP 合同：POST /api/v1/comparison-runs，request {tenantId,ruleSetId,baselineVersionId,candidateVersionId,evaluationIds}，response {run:ComparisonRun}；POST /api/v1/comparison-runs/:comparisonRunId/start，request {expectedRevision}，response {run:ComparisonRun}；POST /api/v1/comparison-runs/:comparisonRunId/cancel，request {expectedRevision}，response {run:ComparisonRun}；POST /api/v1/comparison-runs/:comparisonRunId/promote，request {expectedRevision}，response {run:ComparisonRun,ruleSet:RuleSet}；GET /api/v1/comparison-runs/:comparisonRunId，response {run:ComparisonRun,results:[ComparisonResult,...]}。所有 mutation 要求 Idempotency-Key，未知字段仍须拒绝。start 通过 CAS 从 PENDING 进入 RUNNING；cancel 是 durable fence，旧 lease 此后不得提交 Result。Worker 必须读取存储的 facts，分别用冻结版本求值，生成每个 corpus Evaluation 恰好一个不可变 Result，绝不能修改原 Evaluation。completed run 只有在 expectedRevision 匹配且 ERROR 为零时才能 promote；promotion 只把 RuleSet 的 currentPublishedVersionId 指向 candidate 并增加 publicationRevision，绝不修改 RuleSetVersion。状态冲突返回 409 COMPARISON_REVISION_CONFLICT，存在 ERROR 返回 409 COMPARISON_HAS_ERRORS，且两者都无副作用。新增 COMPARISON_EXECUTE Work 和 comparison.started、comparison.completed、comparison.cancelled、comparison.promoted Events；迁移保留所有 V1 版本、解释、回放、幂等结果、lease 与 Event。UI 增加 corpus、进度、diff、cancel 和 promote。正式 comparison-recovery 场景使用 50,000 个 frozen inputs，SIGKILL 两个已 claim Worker，再启动四个 replacement；必须在 60 秒内完成，每个 corpus Evaluation 恰好一个 Result，不能有 digest drift 或重复 Event。本轮只做影响分析和计划。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更的 schema、状态、迁移、Worker、并发、恢复、Event、UI 和测试影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Manager migration
scenes.objective: Implement compatible migration.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 state and replay remain exact.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证全部 V1 versions、Evaluation、Explanation、Replay、Work、Event 和幂等结果不变。

scenes.title: Comparison execution
scenes.objective: Implement frozen corpus and shadow evaluation.
scenes.advanceGate: Every corpus item has exactly one deterministic result.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 ComparisonRun corpus freeze、start、COMPARISON_EXECUTE、Result digest 和崩溃恢复。

scenes.title: Cancel and promote
scenes.objective: Implement lifecycle fences and CAS promotion.
scenes.advanceGate: Races have one legal outcome.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 cancel durable fence、completed promotion gate、expectedRevision CAS 和不可变历史。

scenes.title: Manager UI and tests
scenes.objective: Complete comparison UI and realistic regressions.
scenes.advanceGate: Browser, migration, race, and recovery tests pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Comparison corpus/progress/diff/cancel/promote UI，并运行 V1_TO_FINAL、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Chromium。

scenes.title: Performance
scenes.objective: Run all formal sustained scenarios.
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式性能场景，报告 throughput、p95、错误、恢复、RSS、数据库增长和负载后确定性。

scenes.title: Final review
scenes.objective: Complete findings-first review and handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: No material finding remains and handoff is accurate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复真实问题，运行完整 gate，并准确总结架构、证据、风险和未运行项。
